_readme: Strategy to Execution gallery. Each category shows up to three samples; categories with no items are hidden. Item fields: type (image|video), src, poster (video thumbnail), alt, title, caption, role, link (case study), fit (cover|contain), position (CSS object-position for the thumbnail), audio (true shows video controls with sound).
